# Daily Hebrew

> Daily Hebrew is a free web app for practicing real, everyday spoken Hebrew, made by Mor, a native Israeli Hebrew teacher. It uses spaced-repetition cards, so each word comes back just before you forget it. No payment needed.

## What you can practice

- Verb conjugation: over 300 Hebrew verbs in the present, past, future, imperative and infinitive.
- Everyday words and phrases: possessives, prepositions with pronouns, adjectives, numbers, question words, place and time.
- Short dialogues and easy reading, with a translation for every line.
- Transliteration and vowels (nikud) that can be switched on and off.
- Levels from complete beginner to advanced.
